verdict: Spend rose this week, but returns dropped — efficiency is the immediate focus.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered a 4.84x return on ad spend across 36 purchases and $7,148 in revenue. In the most recent 7 days, however, ad spend increased 25.69% while purchases fell 21.43% and return on ad spend dropped sharply — more dollars went in and fewer sales came out. Purchase volume has shown a small uptick in the last three days, which is an early signal worth watching but not yet a trend. Ad creative and audience targeting on the top campaign are being refined this week to bring efficiency back in line before spend increases further.

watch_item.issue: Ad spend rose 25.69% week-over-week while purchases and revenue per dollar both declined, signaling the current campaign setup is not converting the added investment.
